hypothesis.statement: The residual is now a single-register colouring offset plus a 3-slot filler rotation, and the register offset is downstream of the delta block: if the second subtraction can be made to reuse its own left operand's register (as `fsubs f1,f1,f5` does in the target) the whole f4..f7 cascade below +0x1a8 should collapse with it. The untried source shape is to give dy alone the compound form (`dy = *py; dy -= v1;`) while dx and dz keep the assignment-in-expression form, i.e. a MIXED spelling chosen per-subtraction rather than uniformly - every probe so far varied all three together.
